mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.git_url, p.git_branch, p.git_commit, p.credential_ref, p.status, p.last_error, p.last_indexed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_document d WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS chunk_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND c.chunk_type != 'FILE') AS symbol_chunk_count, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM ai_code_project p WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.git_url, p.git_branch, p.git_commit, p.credential_ref, p.status, p.last_error, p.last_indexed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_document d WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id) AS chunk_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND c.chunk_type != 'FILE') AS symbol_chunk_count, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM ai_code_project p WHERE p.created_by = #{userId} ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_code_project (id, name, git_url, git_branch, credential_ref, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{gitUrl}, #{gitBranch}, #{credentialRef}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_code_project SET status = #{status}, git_commit = #{gitCommit}, last_error = NULL, last_indexed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
